input: Set up a home network printer for the office

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing whether this is a brand-new printer setup or connecting an existing printer changes every step of the plan — unboxing and driver installation vs. just network configuration.
The number of users and devices that need to print determines whether a simple shared printer or a more robust network setup (e.g., print server, static IP) is needed.
Whether the printer connects via Wi-Fi, Ethernet, or USB-sharing affects the entire technical approach and what equipment is required.
The operating systems in use (Windows, macOS, Linux, mobile) directly determine which drivers, apps, or protocols must be installed on each device.
Knowing the printer's make and model is essential to find the correct drivers, firmware, and manufacturer-specific setup instructions.
Understanding what 'working' means — basic printing only vs. also scanning, faxing, duplex, or cloud printing — defines the scope of the setup task.
The user's technical comfort level determines how detailed and step-by-step the plan needs to be, and whether professional help should be recommended.

gold.taskTitle: Set up a home network printer for the office
gold.taskDescription: Configure a printer so it is accessible over the home network for office use.

questions.title: Is this a new printer or an existing one to reconnect?
questions.description: Determine whether the printer needs to be unboxed and set up from scratch, or if it is already installed and just needs to be added to the network.

questions.title: How many devices or users need to print to it?
questions.description: Find out the number of computers, phones, or users that need access, to decide between a simple shared printer and a more robust network configuration.

questions.title: Will the printer connect via Wi-Fi, Ethernet, or USB?
questions.description: Identify the intended connection method, as this determines the entire technical setup path and required equipment.

questions.title: What operating systems are on the devices that will print?
questions.description: Establish whether the devices run Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, or a mix, since this dictates which drivers or apps must be installed.

questions.title: What is the make and model of the printer?
questions.description: Identify the exact printer model to source the correct drivers, firmware updates, and manufacturer-specific setup guidance.

questions.title: Beyond basic printing, do you need scanning or cloud printing too?
questions.description: Clarify whether the setup should also cover scanning, mobile/cloud printing, or other advanced features, to define the full scope of the task.

questions.title: How comfortable are you with technical network setup steps?
questions.description: Gauge the user's technical skill level to calibrate how detailed and guided the plan should be, and whether professional assistance is worth recommending.
